import { test } from "bun:test";
// Holds about 200 MB here and 30 MB in a child for about 2.5 s, burns about 0.3 s of CPU, then exits 0.
test("FAKE-1-AC1 holds memory", async () => {
  const touch = (megabytes: number) => {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(megabytes * 1024 * 1024);
    for (let at = 0; at < bytes.length; at += 4096) bytes[at] = 1;
    return bytes;
  };
  const held = touch(200);
  const child = Bun.spawn([
    "bun",
    "-e",
    "const b = new Uint8Array(30 * 1024 * 1024); for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 4096) b[i] = 1; await Bun.sleep(2500)",
  ]);
  const end = performance.now() + 300;
  while (performance.now() < end);
  await child.exited;
  if (held[0] !== 1) throw new Error("memory was dropped");
});
